response.sql:
WITH filtered_telescopes AS (
  SELECT 
    t.observstation,
    o.weathprofile,
    t.bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE t.pointaccarc >= 4.86
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    weathprofile,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS group_avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM filtered_telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation, weathprofile
)
SELECT 
  AVG(group_avg_bandwidth) AS avg_of_group_averages,
  AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_of_group_counts
FROM group_stats

assumptions.assumption: "The number of telescopes" in each group refers to all telescopes in that (observstation, weathprofile) group, including those with NULL bandwidth values. The phrase "ignoring missing values" applies only to the bandwidth average calculation.

alternatives.interpretation: "The number of telescopes" refers only to telescopes with non-NULL bandwidth values in each group. This would align the count with the "ignoring missing values" approach applied to the bandwidth.
